description:
Legend has it that whenever evil has appeared, a hero named Link has arisen to defeat it. The legend continues on
the surface of a vast and mysterious sea as Link sets sail in his most epic, awe-inspiring adventure yet. Aided by a
magical conductor's baton called the Wind Waker, he will face unimaginable monsters, explore puzzling dungeons, and
meet a cast of unforgettable characters as he searches for his kidnapped sister.

v1.1.0-beta.description:
**Note: Make sure to remove old wwhd apworlds from your custom_worlds folder! this could cause conflicts!!**
# 1.1.0 Release

## Wii U Support
- Added Wii U support for this APWorld. This is the first world to be natively supported by the wii u!
- A small helper plugin is needed for connecting to the Wii U. Instructions for this are in the [setup guide](https://github.com/Teotia444/twwhd-apworld/blob/main/docs/setup_en.md). This has been tested enough to be considered stable.

## Fixes
- Various linux fixes and fixes to fetch the base address
- Added Flatpak support for linux
- Improved the get item function so duplicates should be way less reoccurring
- Improved the French and Spanish translation for AP specif things

## Additions
- Added blue chus as an actual item so you can give them your starting pool
- Added both `Windfall Island - Auction 100 Rupee` + `Windfall Island - Dampa Pig Minigame` as additional checks
- Added the option to start with a random item slide item, this can be chosen from Grapple, Boomerang, Bow or Hookshot
- Added a bunch of metadata stuff for the patcher. This includes a new icon and title, a new logo, a model and some flavor text for AP items. Fathers letter begone!
- Added C(hest) T(ype) M(atches) C(ontent). This makes chest appear wooden if they contain junk, or spiky if they're progressive.
- Added hints as an experimental option. Hints are completely generated by the patcher with no knowledge of the multiworld rn, but it should still be somewhat coherent. Specifically: Ho Ho (Triforce) Hints will hint items (or exclusively triforce pieces from any game having them) from the old man Ho Ho, Kreeb Hints will hint all items of type "Bow" in your local world, and Korl Hints hint classic path, items, barren or location hints.
- Added performance option for Wii U to reduce lag in certain areas
- Added fix rng option for fixing rng in certain places
- Added better version control for the APworld

v1.1.1-beta.description:
# 1.1.1 Release

## Fixes
- Fixed some logic mishaps (as usual). Namely, `Windfall Island - Dampa Pig Minigame`, `Forbidden Woods - Hole In Tree Chest` and `Forsaken Fortress - Chest Guarded by Bokoblin` are now using adequate logic.
- Made the client work better with disconnect and crashes. Now, if an error occurs, keeping the same client opened and reconnecting should work just fine for Cemu and for Wii U.
- Improved the Wii U connectivity and made it so that the release message doesn't flood the screen with notifications, instead just displaying that a player released their worlds.
- Fixed a connectivity issue with the Wii U where sometimes, the plugin would not initialize properly.
- Greatly improved the tracker's connectivity with AP, so now it will connect faster. Fixed a couple glitches with it, mainly the tracker does not double check an item if you've clicked on connect twice now, and all locations count are fixed.
- Fixed tracker (auto)saves. Now you can save and load tracker saves with no issue. This is especially useful for Entrance Rando which is not saved through AP right now. Also saving the AP IP/slot now.
- Fixed ER sometimes decoupling entrances even though it is not supposed to do that. Now, everything is coupled. Could probably add a decoupled option in the next release.
- Fixed hints generation sometimes miscalculating the numbers of hints to generate and causing KoRL to yap forever.

## Additions
- The client will now try to automatically input the slot to the server once you are in game. The slot is displayed on the title screen along with the AP Seed hash. You can still manually connect to a slot if you connect to a server by using `/connect slot:pwd@server:port`.

As usual, instructions for this APWorld are in the [setup guide](https://github.com/Teotia444/twwhd-apworld/blob/main/docs/setup_en.md).

**Note: if you're updating from < 1.1.0, make sure to remove old wwhd apworlds from your custom_worlds folder! this could cause conflicts!!**
